We are playing TF2! #334 Anonymous 11/08/26(Sun)01:26:29 No.43695612
Smissmas is coming edition
Thread theme: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lgI7Ce2GUTY
Previous thread: >>43557062

Pony maps, sprays, and micspam!
Reskinned vanilla maps (with mares) by our very own anons!
Come relive the heyday of pony TF2 with your friends from /mlp/!

Visit this link to check out the server info from your browser: https://tf2.pony.horse/
Server stats are available here: https://tf2.pony.horse/psychostats


>Server info
Server IP: tf2.pony.horse OR 169.128.191.130:27015
Password: check filename
Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/mlptf2_
The steam group chat is active, come and say hello!

Map downloads (place the .bsp file in /tf/download/maps): https://fastdl.pony.horse/mlptf2/maps/
Download demos from matches (request demos in the thread): https://fastdl.pony.horse/mlptf2/demos/
Demo archive of all matches played from March 10th 2026 to June 23: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1r-baaF2XKLhmXPQpr3DEqdlGMCEhHKGy?usp=drive_link
Active hours: 7-9pm to 12-4am EDT (32-64 players)
Custom game modes are available for everyone to enable. type !votemvm, !votedeathrun, !votesurf, !votejump, or !votedodgeball in-game to start!

This server uses a plugin that changes the stats of some weapons to an old pre-nerf version. See https://github.com/rsedxcftvgyhbujnkiqwe/castaway-plugins/wiki/Weapon-Revert-List for more info. Not all reverts are active, for a list of all available reverts type !reverts in game

Consider installing mastercomfig if you have frequent frame drops, bad hitreg, poor network connectivity, or are new to the game. See https://mastercomfig.com/ for easy installation. It is STRONGLY recommended that all players install some preset of mastercomfig since TF2's default netcode settings have not been changed since 2007.

THERE IS NO DISCORD SERVER ASSOCIATED WITH THIS THREAD. Any post mentioning "the /mlp/ TF2 Discord" is a troll and should be ignored.
/vg/-style chatroom-posting and gayposting is OFF-TOPIC and should be reported as such.


No one is judged for being new to the game, and skill level across the playerbase varies.
Join the fun!
